import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample DataFrame with string user_id and float64 score
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [85.5, 92.3, 78.6]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df_nw = nw.from_native(df)

# Convert dtypes: user_id to Int32, score to Float32
df_converted = df_nw.with_columns([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
])

# Convert back to native and return
result = nw.to_native(df_converted)
print(result)
print("\nDtypes:")
print(result.dtypes)
